name: Grade 6 T2 Summative: Robotics Vocabulary
description: Ten core second-trimester words for the Grade 6 robotics summative vocabulary table.

words.definition: A machine that can follow instructions to do a task.
words.example: The robot followed the taped path across the classroom floor.

words.definition: A small classroom robot used for coding and testing.
words.example: The team programmed the mBot to stop at the finish marker.

words.definition: A set of instructions a computer or robot follows.
words.example: The program made the robot move forward, turn, and stop.

words.definition: One step that tells a computer or robot what to do.
words.example: The first instruction told the robot to move forward for two seconds.

words.definition: Acting in a way that protects people and materials.
words.example: The group followed safety rules by keeping hands away from the moving wheels.

words.definition: A part that makes something move.
words.example: The motor turned the left wheel during the robot test.

words.definition: A round part that helps a robot move.
words.example: The wheel slipped, so the team lowered the robot speed.

words.definition: A robot part that notices objects, light, or distance.
words.example: The sensor detected a box in front of the robot.

words.definition: A robot light used to show a state or warning.
words.example: The LED turned red when the robot reached the warning zone.

words.definition: A small part that makes a sound.
words.example: The buzzer made a short beep after the robot finished the route.
